inputs.name: infisical_version
inputs.description: Tag of the docker.io/infisical/infisical image, such as "v0.167.4". Change image_digest with it.

inputs.name: image_digest
inputs.description: Digest of the image for infisical_version, such as "sha256:80a3...". Podman pulls by the digest, so a tag that moves upstream can't change what runs.

inputs.name: site_url
inputs.description: The address people and clients reach Infisical at, such as "https://secrets.example.com". Infisical uses it for CORS, links in emails and SSO redirects.

inputs.name: db_connection_uri
inputs.description: PostgreSQL connection URI, such as "postgres://infisical:PASSWORD@127.0.0.1:5432/infisical". It reaches the host in a root-only file and never the plan or state.

inputs.name: redis_url
inputs.description: Redis or Valkey URL, such as "redis://:PASSWORD@127.0.0.1:6379". It reaches the host in a root-only file and never the plan or state.

inputs.name: listen_address
inputs.description: Address Infisical listens on. The default keeps it on the host for a reverse proxy in front; "0.0.0.0" listens on every address.

inputs.name: environment
inputs.description: More of Infisical's environment variables, such as { SMTP_HOST = "smtp.example.com", SMTP_PASSWORD = "...", TELEMETRY_ENABLED = "false" }. They go in the same root-only file as the connection settings and never reach the plan or state.
